title: Supply Risk Monitoring, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Supply Risk Monitoring agent on real SharePoint lists that hold the workshop's synthetic records, with its own managed app. Easy mode has brainfreeze studio build all of it; Manual mode builds the same thing by hand.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 3 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Supply Risk Monitoring Suppliers list.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including TechnoCore Semiconductor (Taiwan) (SupplierId SUP-101), with Category Microcontrollers.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Supply Risk Monitoring Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 4 skills, 1 rules knowledge file(s) and 3 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Supply Chain Director
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Where is supplier exposure concentrated, and which relationships should leadership review first?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: TechnoCore Semiconductor; CRITICAL. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Procurement Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Explain why TechnoCore is elevated and show me the evidence by risk dimension.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: SUP-101; Geopolitical. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Supply Chain Director
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which recorded disruptions could threaten continuity, and what exposure should we validate?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: SUP-104; force majeure. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Procurement Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Compare backup sourcing options for review, but do not contact, qualify, select, or order from any supplier.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Murata Electronics; No supplier was contacted. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Supply Risk Monitoring: 3 read-only tabs from the same lists. 5 fictional records, including TechnoCore Semiconductor (Taiwan) (SupplierId SUP-101), with Category Microcontrollers.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Supply Risk Monitoring Suppliers from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload suppliers.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set SupplierId, Category, Region, Country to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep AnnualSpend, QualityScore, DeliveryScore, FinancialScore, GeopoliticalScore, OverallRisk, Tier as Number. Name the list Supply Risk Monitoring Suppliers. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including TechnoCore Semiconductor (Taiwan) (SupplierId SUP-101), with Category Microcontrollers.

steps.title: Create Supply Risk Monitoring Recent Incidents from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload recent-incidents.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set RecentIncidentId, SupplierID, Date, Severity to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Name the list Supply Risk Monitoring Recent Incidents. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including Cross-strait military exercises caused 5-day port closure; delayed 3 shipments (RecentIncidentId 1), with SupplierID SUP-101.

steps.title: Create Supply Risk Monitoring Backup Suppliers from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload backup-suppliers.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set BackupSupplierId, Value to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Name the list Supply Risk Monitoring Backup Suppliers. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 3 fictional records, including SUP-101 (BackupSupplierId SUP-101).

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Supply Risk M Studio Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there.
steps.expected: The studio instructions name the 3 list tools and map every Title and field_N column.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload aibast_supplier-risk-monitoring-review-rules.md, and wait until ready. Do not upload the synthetic-records file: those records come from the list tools.
steps.expected: 1 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the suppliers tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Supply Risk Monitoring Suppliers; name the tool Get supplier records.
steps.expected: Get supplier records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the recent incidents tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Supply Risk Monitoring Recent Incidents; name the tool Get recent incident records.
steps.expected: Get recent incident records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the backup suppliers tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Supply Risk Monitoring Backup Suppliers; name the tool Get backup supplier records.
steps.expected: Get backup supplier records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 4 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 4 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 4 skills, the rules knowledge and 3 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 4 skills, 1 knowledge file(s), 3 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else.

steps.title: Test: Supply Chain Director
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Where is supplier exposure concentrated, and which relationships should leadership review first?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: TechnoCore Semiconductor; CRITICAL. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Procurement Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Explain why TechnoCore is elevated and show me the evidence by risk dimension.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: SUP-101; Geopolitical. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Supply Chain Director
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which recorded disruptions could threaten continuity, and what exposure should we validate?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: SUP-104; force majeure. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Procurement Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Compare backup sourcing options for review, but do not contact, qualify, select, or order from any supplier.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Murata Electronics; No supplier was contacted. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: supplier-risk-monitoring-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 3 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Supply Risk Monitoring Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Supply Risk Monitoring Suppliers" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Supply Risk Monitoring Recent Incidents" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Supply Risk Monitoring Backup Suppliers" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 3 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Supply Risk Monitoring Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Supply Risk Monitoring Suppliers tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 5 fictional records, including TechnoCore Semiconductor (Taiwan) (SupplierId SUP-101), with Category Microcontrollers.
